metadata.title: Axial currents recordings in mouse retinal ganglion cells
metadata.description: Patch-clamp recordings in mouse retinal ganglion cells performed by Martijn Sierksma. It comprises axial currents recorded in voltage clamp, spontaneous activity and the response to current pulses. The cells were filled with biocytin and subsequently labelled for ankyrin G. The dataset comprises confocal images of the full neurons morphology and their axon initial segments performed by Sarah Goethals.
